sources.title: Hao–Mukai: Feature Line Rendering from Rasterization States in 3D Gaussian Splatting, author preprint, SA2026

quotes.text: The output remains a view-dependent raster field rather than a persistent 3D stroke representation.
The support-change response is therefore activated only when a change in Gaussian support coincides with layer competition and a depth, opacity, or visibility response.
Our method is simple and easy to implement.
